QuestInfo.name: Equipment Check
QuestInfo.0: It's time for your training session, but something's missing...
QuestInfo.1:
Try #bEquipping some equipment#k.

#rIf you've lost your sword#k, talk to #b#eFather#n#k to get a new weapon. 

#e[How to Equip]#n\n
1. Open the item inventory window by pressing the hotkey I.\n
2. Double-click on the item, or left-click and drag it into your Equip window to equip.\n
3. Open the Equip window by pressing the hotkey E to make sure it's equipped.\n
QuestInfo.2: You've learned how to equip items! Press the I hotkey to open the inventory window, and then double-click on the item to equip it. Open the Equip window by pressing the E hotkey, and double-click on the item to unequip it.

0.msg: Equip the #rBeginner Warrior's Sword#k on the #bEquip Tab#k.\r\n\r\nIf you've lost your sword, go tell Father.
